name: Peril in the Agency
source:
A group of handsome men have gone missing! It's your job to rescue them, and maybe even romance them along the way. But if you're looking after everyone else, then who's going to rescue you?

[From [url=https://indistressart.itch.io/peril-in-the-agency]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一群帅哥失踪了！你的工作就是拯救他们，甚至可能一路上与他们发生浪漫关系。但如果你照顾其他人，那么谁来拯救你呢？

[来自[url=https://indistressart.itch.io/peril-in-the-agency]itch.io[/url]]
